notes.text: Sir Alexander Fleming was a Scottish physician and microbiologist.
Alexander Fleming shared the 1945 Nobel Prize in Physiology or Medicine with Howard Florey and Ernst Chain "for the discovery of penicillin and its curative effect in various infectious diseases".
Alexander Fleming is remembered as a biologist connected with United Kingdom.
Alexander Fleming's recorded life dates place this profile around 1881-1955.
Alexander Fleming is grouped with Science, Math & Technology in the People Library.
